item.title: Breaking the Ice: New Robins Kaplan partner ‘felt called’
item.description: Former Hennepin County prosecutor Raoul Shah has been promoted to partner at Robins Kaplan, focusing on personal injury, medical malpractice and civil rights.

item.title: Judge cancels ICE chief contempt hearing after detainee released
item.description: A Minnesota federal judge canceled a contempt hearing after ICE released a wrongfully detained man but warned agency leaders over ignored court orders.

item.title: Pass-through entity tax has expired. What now?
item.description: Minnesota’s pass-through entity tax expired at the end of 2025, leaving businesses uncertain whether lawmakers will reinstate the SALT workaround.

item.title: Judge tosses federal murder charges in UnitedHealthcare CEO killing
item.description: A New York federal judge dismissed murder and weapons charges against Luigi Mangione, removing the possibility of a federal death penalty.
